inspection_summary.window_note: CMS publishes about the three most recent standard surveys plus complaint and infection-control inspections from the prior three years. Older findings leave the dataset; their absence is not evidence they never happened.

cms-k0293.title: Have properly located and lighted "Exit" signs.

cms-k0919.title: Meet requirements for the use of electrical equipment.
cms-k0919.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0920.title: Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.
cms-k0920.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0812.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

cms-f0842.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
cms-f0842.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0550.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

cms-f0561.title: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

cms-f0605.title: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
cms-f0605.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0644.title: Coordinate assessments with the pre-admission screening and resident review program; and referring for services as needed.
cms-f0644.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0684.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
cms-f0684.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0689.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
cms-f0689.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0600.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
cms-f0600.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0761.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

cms-f0656.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
cms-f0656.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0658.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
cms-f0658.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0760.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

cms-f0880.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

cms-k0712.title: Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.

cms-k0918.title: Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
cms-k0918.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0926.title: Ensure that personnel concerned with handling of medical gases and cylinders are trained on the risk.
cms-k0926.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0363.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.

cms-k0353.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.

cms-f0577.title: Allow residents to easily view the nursing home's survey results and communicate with advocate agencies.

cms-f0584.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

cms-f0585.title: Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.

cms-f0679.title: Provide activities to meet all resident's needs.
cms-f0679.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0921.title: Make sure that the nursing home area is safe, easy to use, clean and comfortable for residents, staff and the public.

cms-f0940.title: Develop, implement, and/or maintain an effective training program for all new and existing staff members.

cms-f0623.title: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.

cms-f0726.title: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

cms-k0923.title: Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
cms-k0923.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0675.title: Honor each resident's preferences, choices, values and beliefs.
cms-f0675.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0867.title: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action.

cms-f0695.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
cms-f0695.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0697.title: Provide safe, appropriate pain management for a resident who requires such services.
cms-f0697.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0800.title: Provide each resident with a nourishing, palatable, well-balanced diet that meets his or her daily nutritional and special dietary needs.
